organization.title: The Philippine Disaster Resilience Foundation
organization.description:
The Philippine Disaster Resilience Foundation,(PDRF) is the Philippines’ major private sector vehicle and coordinator for disaster risk and reduction management. Established in 2010, PDRF is an alliance of over 70 businesses dedicated to building the disaster risk management capabilities of the private sector, contributing to sustainable development and the general welfare of the Filipino people.

PDRF works across all areas of disaster management: prevention and mitigation, preparedness, response, and rehabilitation and recovery. It fosters a whole-of-society approach, bridging partnerships with communities, government agencies, local government units, humanitarian organizations, and private sector entities. This collaboration embodies solidarity that transcends business competition, united by a common vision of a disaster-ready and resilient Philippines.
